policy: Entities are cross-checked by explicit LegacyEntitySpec, source class and active registration. Item/block literal and symbol matches are ONLY review candidates until registry identity, class constructors, variants and runtime are verified. No missing-object verdict may be inferred from a nonmatch.
limitations: Missing same-ID is NOT proof of missing feature; 1.12.2 metadata families can be split into modern ItemStack IDs
Constructor string candidates require inspection of registry name implementation in the original class
Dynamic colors and special banner are separate block IDs in original, not necessarily preserved as distinct modern blocks
Other legacy item/block declarations, registry side effects, entity spawn metadata and original JAR need independent census
Port ItemStacks, resource parents and client rendering are not verified
Variant-name permutations are only candidate IDs; vanilla item reuse and port component-based variants require runtime confirmation
